jobs.title: Middle/Senior Unity Developer R&D
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Middle/Senior Unity Developer R&D based in Netherlands.

As a Middle/Senior Unity Developer R&D, you’ll help evolve a live mobile game by building new gameplay systems, LiveOps features, and scalable technical solutions.

You’ll work across the full development lifecycle, from implementing new mechanics to improving architecture, performance, stability, and maintainability.

A strong focus of the role is on modern AI-assisted development, with opportunities to integrate AI agents into real production workflows and automate recurring engineering tasks.

You’ll investigate real-world production issues using telemetry and profiling data, ensuring a smooth experience across a wide range of mobile devices.

The role also offers significant technical ownership, including participation in architectural decisions, code reviews, optimization initiatives, and development practices.

You’ll collaborate closely with other technical and product-focused team members while contributing ideas that can improve both engineering efficiency and the game itself.

This is an R&D-oriented opportunity for a developer who enjoys solving complex technical problems, experimenting with new tools, and seeing their work make a measurable product impact.

Accountabilities

Develop and maintain gameplay systems and features using Unity and C# within a released mobile game, while evolving architecture and reducing technical debt.
Implement and maintain LiveOps functionality, including events, promotions, seasonal content, and A/B testing.
Work with Addressables, Asset Bundles, CDN delivery, and Remote Configs to enable content and feature updates without requiring a full application release.
Actively use AI agents such as Cursor, Claude Code, or equivalent tools in day-to-day development on a real production codebase.
Create and maintain internal AI skills, rules, and agent instructions that automate recurring team workflows while taking responsibility for the quality of generated results.
Investigate and resolve ANRs, crashes, freezes, OOM issues, and other production problems using real telemetry and diagnostic data.
Optimize CPU usage, memory consumption, startup time, application size, and downloadable content for different classes of Android devices.
Integrate and maintain advertising, analytics, monetization, and third-party SDKs while ensuring tracking and event implementation remain accurate.
Conduct code reviews and contribute to important technical and architectural decisions.
Share effective AI-assisted development practices and help improve the team's engineering workflows.
Profile and optimize Android and iOS applications using tools such as Unity Profiler, Crashlytics, and Android Vitals.
Investigate performance regressions and follow complex technical issues from symptoms through root-cause analysis, implementation, and validation of results.
Consider product metrics such as retention, CPI, and LTV when evaluating technical and gameplay decisions.

Requirements

3+ years of commercial experience with Unity and C#, including experience working on released mobile games and supporting projects through LiveOps rather than only developing them prior to launch.
Strong understanding of Unity project architecture, including design patterns, dependency injection with tools such as Zenject or VContainer, asynchronous programming with UniTask, Unity lifecycle, memory management, and garbage collection.
Practical experience with AI development agents such as Cursor, Claude Code, or comparable tools, including the ability to decompose tasks, provide appropriate context from large codebases, and validate generated code.
Experience with MCP, including Unity MCP or similar approaches, as well as skills, rules, and agent-instruction workflows.
Ability to document team development practices in a way that allows AI agents to reproduce them consistently.
Hands-on experience with Addressables, Asset Bundles, CDN delivery, Remote Configs, versioning, caching, and fallback scenarios.
Strong profiling and optimization experience across Android and/or iOS, including investigation of ANRs, crashes, OOM issues, and production performance regressions.
Understanding of low-end Android devices, device fragmentation, and mobile build-size optimization.
Experience integrating third-party SDKs for advertising, analytics, and in-app purchases.
Familiarity with Git workflows, code review practices, and CI/CD.
Ability to take a complex technical problem from symptom identification through root-cause analysis, solution implementation, and verification of the outcome.
Understanding of product metrics such as retention, CPI, and LTV.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a proactive approach to technical challenges.
Ability to work independently, take ownership of technical decisions, and communicate complex engineering topics clearly.
Experience in an R&D-oriented environment is advantageous.
Professional Ukrainian language proficiency is expected.

Benefits

Fully remote work within Europe, with remote-first flexibility.
Personal benefit budget that can be allocated toward insurance, education, fitness, or other areas supporting personal wellbeing.
Performance-based bonuses recognizing meaningful results, initiative, and contribution to team success.
High level of autonomy with minimal bureaucracy and the opportunity to influence technical and product decisions.
Professional development through learning opportunities, internal training, and strategic sessions.
Opportunity to work with modern AI-assisted development tools and contribute to innovative engineering practices.
Collaborative team environment focused on shared ownership and collective results.
Direct opportunity to contribute to the evolution of a live mobile game and its underlying technology.
Full-time position within a Gameplay Development environment.
Interview process consisting of a recruiter interview, test assignment, technical interview, reference collection, and offer stage.

to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Warum SoftwareOne?

SoftwareOne ist ein globaler Anbieter für Software- und Cloud-Lösungen. Mit einer Präsenz in über 70 Ländern und mehr als 12.000 Mitarbeitenden unterstützen wir Unternehmen dabei, ihre Software-Investitionen zu optimieren, Anwendungen zu modernisieren und das volle Potenzial von Cloud, Data und AI zu erschließen.

Was uns ausmacht, sind die Menschen bei SoftwareOne. Wir ermöglichen Zusammenarbeit über Ländergrenzen hinweg, fördern kontinuierliches Lernen und schaffen Raum für Entwicklung in einer sich ständig wandelnden Technologielandschaft. Ob dein Fokus auf Technologie, Customer Success oder Business Operations liegt – deine Ideen zählen und dein Beitrag macht einen Unterschied.

Werde Teil eines globalen Teams, in dem du deine Fähigkeiten weiterentwickelst, mit führenden Technologien arbeitest und echten Mehrwert für unsere Kunden schaffst.

Suchst du eine Rolle, in der du dich tief auf komplexe Microsoft-Azure-Infrastrukturen spezialisieren und technische Entscheidungen prägen kannst?
Möchtest du nicht nur „Tickets abarbeiten“, sondern langfristig Kundenumgebungen mitgestalten, modernisieren und sicherer machen?
Bist du bereit in Enterprise Azure Umgebungen unserer Kunden der wirklich Wirkung zu erzielen?

Standort:
Bundesweit, Deutschland | Arbeitsmodell:
Hybrid / Remote mit Vor-Ort-Einsätzen | Sprachen
:
Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse | Umfang:
Vollzeit | Rufbereitschaft und gelegentliche Vor-Ort-Einsätze

Administration von Azure-Netzwerken, virtuellen Maschinen, Datenbanken, Identitäten, Berechtigungen und Richtlinien

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Post-Trade (F8B34C7)
jobs.description:
Referment is working with a quantitative investment manager to hire a Senior Software Engineer for its post-trade and reporting team. You will build the systems used by operations and fund accounting, combining backend engineering with a close understanding of the business processes the software supports.

There is no business analyst layer between you and the people using these systems. You will discuss their requirements directly, work through the design and carry the solution into production. That makes this a role for someone who wants to understand why a system is needed as well as how to build it.

The remit spans new projects and improvements to existing services. Alongside delivery, you will help shape the platform's technical direction and make its distributed, event-driven systems easier to monitor, operate and maintain.

The Role

Work with operations, fund accounting and senior stakeholders to define problems and agree practical software solutions.
Take changes through architecture, data modelling, implementation, automated testing and release.
Build backend services that handle failure predictably, with monitoring and alerting that make production behaviour visible.
Improve shared components and delivery tooling, including CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code.
Contribute to design reviews and technical decisions, balancing new approaches with the needs of an operating investment business.

What We're Looking For

At least five years of professional software development, including cloud-distributed, event-driven or microservices-based systems.
Strong backend engineering and computer science fundamentals. C#/.NET is preferred, with relevant experience in comparable technologies also valuable.
A STEM degree and a disciplined approach to testing, documentation, version control and maintainable design.
Confidence gathering requirements and explaining technical choices directly to business users.
Curiosity about development tools, including AI-assisted engineering, alongside sound judgement about where to use them.

Useful Background

The environment includes AWS, Docker and Kubernetes, with PostgreSQL and SQL Server for data and Angular/TypeScript on the frontend. Database tuning and financial-services experience are useful, rather than prerequisites for every candidate.

This could suit a backend engineer who enjoys business-facing ownership and wants to stay involved after the code reaches production, rather than hand off a finished component and move on.

At MHR, our employees are central to our success and play a key role in helping customers achieve sustainable high performance. With a team of over 900 professionals, we work to make things flow smoothly, whether it's for large organisations or individual employees. As businesses face rapid changes in the world of work, our team is here to help them adapt and thrive. 

By focusing on the core needs of efficiency, productivity, growth, and impact, our employees use their expertise to deliver real solutions through our People and Finance platform. This system, which covers finance, HR, payroll, and learning, helps businesses run more smoothly and make better decisions in real time.

With over 40 years of experience behind us, MHR’s track record as a high-performance organisation is built on clear goals, a shared vision, and strong communication - all of which we pass on to our customers. 

MHR is more than just a place to work; it’s a platform for empowerment. Joining us means bringing innovation, technology, and teamwork seamlessly removes obstacles, enhances your skills, and allow you to focus on what’s most important to you- work that matters.

With us, you’ll grow, find your flow, and make a lasting difference in your career, your team, and your impact. 

Your Career

As a Software Engineering Manager at MHR, you'll lead a cross-functional team of Software Engineers and Test Engineers, helping build the next generation of our cloud-based HR and Payroll platform. You'll combine people leadership with technical influence, fostering a culture of engineering excellence, test-driven development and continuous improvement.

Working with modern technologies including .NET, Angular, Azure and AI-assisted development tools, you'll help shape how software is built while supporting the growth and success of your team.

Your Team

You'll lead a collaborative Agile team of engineers and testers, working closely with Product and Scrum teams to deliver high-quality software. We value shared ownership, continuous learning and a growth mindset, creating an environment where people can do their best work and develop their careers.

Your Impact

You'll be responsible for building high-performing teams, improving engineering practices and ensuring the delivery of scalable, maintainable software. Through coaching, mentoring and technical leadership, you'll help shape both our products and our engineering culture.

What You'll Be Doing

Lead, coach and develop a cross-functional engineering team.
Drive a culture of quality, test-driven development and continuous improvement.
Support the delivery of scalable, maintainable software and architecture.
Partner with Product and Scrum teams to deliver against product roadmaps.
Remove delivery obstacles and improve team effectiveness.
Support recruitment, talent development and succession planning.
Champion AI-assisted development practices to improve productivity and quality.

What We're Looking For

Experience leading or mentoring software engineers within Agile teams.
Strong software engineering background
Passion for engineering excellence, code quality and test-driven development.
Experience driving continuous improvement and high-performing teams.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
Interest in modern engineering practices, cloud technologies and AI-assisted development.

Benefits To Support You Personally And Professionally

Alongside the opportunity to work with an incredible team and express your individuality, we offer a range of personalised benefits including:

Access to over 60 internal training courses, professional qualifications, and cross-departmental mentoring and coaching programs
24/7 access to a GP through Help at Hand for you and your family, confidential mental health support, and paid sick leave
Ability to purchase or sell additional holiday days beyond 25 days and bank holidays
Enhanced Family leave
My MHRewards offering discounts at over 900 retailers
Monthly employee recognition program and departmental awards
Referral bonus scheme of up to £2,000
Employee-led social events such as running clubs, football teams, book clubs, and bake-offs
On-site subsidised restaurants offering a variety of fresh meals daily
Opt-in benefits schemes such as private medical insurance and dental coverage

We value the well-being, financial stability, and inclusivity of our employees, and strive to provide a supportive working environment.

At MHR, we’re completely committed to creating a supportive and inclusive workplace where all voices are heard, and everyone feels valued and supported.

Whatever your background, abilities and experiences, if you’re excited by this role we want to hear from you. If you require assistance for an interview, please let us know and we’ll make sure your needs are met when you arrive.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Principal Engineer, AI-Driven Software Delivery to help shape how SP Digital Engineering builds, tests and delivers software in the AI era. This is a hands-on technical leadership role focused on improving developer productivity, software quality and delivery confidence through AI-assisted engineering practices, modern delivery platforms and automated quality controls.

The successful candidate will work across engineering, architecture, DevSecOps, cyber security, product and business teams to establish practical standards, reusable patterns and self-service capabilities that accelerate software delivery while maintaining reliability, security and compliance. Define and drive the strategy, roadmap and engineering standards for AI-driven software delivery across SP Digital Engineering.
Establish consistent practices for requirements specification, solution design, coding, code review, testing, release and production readiness in an AI-assisted engineering environment.

Develop reusable playbooks, reference architectures, templates and automation patterns that enable teams to adopt AI-driven delivery practices consistently.
Evaluate emerging AI engineering tools, coding agents and delivery technologies, and recommend adoption based on measurable value, security, cost and operational suitability.

Developer Productivity & Quality Engineering Platforms

Lead the design and adoption of developer productivity and quality engineering capabilities, including automated testing, test data, CI/CD quality gates and software delivery metrics.
Define enterprise-ready test automation patterns across unit, API, contract, integration, end-to-end, performance, resilience and security testing.
Establish repeatable evaluation, regression testing and quality verification approaches for AI-generated code, specifications, tests and documentation.
Improve software delivery flow by reducing manual effort, improving test reliability, shortening feedback cycles and increasing confidence in releases.

Voor een project rond het Centraal Huurdersregister/Activering en een AI-SDLC-traject zoeken we een senior tester/test automator die functionele validaties combineert met het opvolgen, controleren, bijsturen en uitvoeren van testen en testautomatisatie binnen AI-gedreven ontwikkelingen.

Je werkt in een context waar digitalisering, beleidswijzigingen en snelle aanpassingen aan applicaties centraal staan. Daarbij wordt ook AI ingezet binnen de software development lifecycle. Daarom zoeken we iemand met een stevige technische basis én een uitgesproken testing-mindset, die AI-gegenereerde testscenario’s en scripts kritisch kan beoordelen en verbeteren.

In deze rol sta je voornamelijk in voor de opvolging van testactiviteiten op systeemniveau voor CHR/Activering, inclusief testartefacten die al dan niet met AI zijn opgebouwd.

Je analyseert beschikbare documentatie om te bepalen hoe functionele procedures en taken zich moeten gedragen.
Je beschrijft testscenario’s voor CHR/Activering.
Je analyseert testcases en scripts die door AI werden opgeleverd op basis van business stories en acceptatiecriteria, en vult die waar nodig aan.
Je voert manuele testen uit en controleert testcases en scripts op scope, volledigheid en correctheid.
Je past testcases en scripts aan of breidt ze uit wanneer dat nodig is.
Je verrijkt de testset met bijkomende testcases en scripts die nog niet voorzien zijn.
Je vergelijkt de coverage en resultaten van manuele testcases binnen CHR/Activering met de output van AI-testscripts.
Je geeft feedback aan het AI-SDLC-team over de kwaliteit en dekking van AI-gegenereerde testscripts.
Je neemt deel aan agile ceremonies zoals demo’s, stand-ups en retrospectives met de betrokken teams.
Je volgt sprintopvolging op in Jira, raadpleegt documentatie in Confluence en beheert testcases in Zephyr.

De opdracht situeert zich binnen toepassingen die gegevens over sociale huurders en verhuurprocessen registreren en ondersteunen. Daarnaast wordt binnen een AI-SDLC-piloot gevalideerd hoe AI kan bijdragen aan analyse, ontwikkeling, testing, documentatie en kwaliteitsbewaking op een gecontroleerde en schaalbare manier.

Jouw profiel

Je bent een ervaren testspecialist met expertise in het testen van grote bedrijfskritische toepassingen.
Je beheerst formele testmethoden en -technieken en hebt een goede kennis van testmethodologie, zoals ISTQB en Agile.
Je hebt ervaring met functionele testen en met BDD-testscripts.
Je hebt ervaring met het testen van bedrijfstoepassingen, inclusief transactiesystemen en integraties met aanverwante systemen.
Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met softwareontwikkeling volgens de SCRUM-methodiek.
Je kan testresultaten helder rapporteren en documenteren.
Je hebt ervaring met Jira voor sprintopvolging en met Zephyr voor het beheer van testcycli en het beschrijven van testcases.
TypeScript is vereist.
Ervaring als test automator is noodzakelijk.
Kennis van Playwright voor het scripten van testcases is een sterke meerwaarde.
Ervaring met specialistische testingtools of testsuites is een plus.
Kennis van Leapwork is een belangrijke troef.
Ervaring met een TDD-werkmethodiek is een pluspunt.
Je begrijpt het principe van shift left en kan dit concreet toepassen in een agile team.
Je kan de belangrijkste businessprocessen in hun geheel begrijpen en tegelijk in detail werken binnen de processen waarvoor je verantwoordelijk bent.
Je bent klant- en resultaatgericht.
Je beschikt over een sterk analytisch en synthetisch denkvermogen en werkt zorgvuldig, gestructureerd en met respect voor deadlines.

Aanbod

Wer wir sind

EKZ ist einer der grössten Energiedienstleister der Schweiz und versorgt zuverlässig rund eine Million Menschen mit Strom aus 100 Prozent erneuerbarer Energie. Die rund 1'600 Mitarbeitenden der EKZ-Gruppe setzen sich für eine nachhaltige Energiezukunft ein: mit dem Ausbau von Wind-, Wasser- und Solarenergie sowie smarten Technologien wie Ladelösungen für die Elektromobilität. EKZ plant, baut und unterhält ein über 17 000 Kilometer langes und mit 99,998 Prozent überdurchschnittlich verfügbares Stromnetz. Zu den Kunden von EKZ zählen Private, Unternehmen und andere Schweizer Energieversorger. Als einer der grössten Ausbildner im Kanton Zürich bildet EKZ 155 Fachkräfte in neun Lehrberufen aus.

Business Solution Architect

80-100%
Dafür setzt du deine Energie ein!
In dieser Schlüsselrolle bewegst du dich an der Schnittstelle von Business, IT und OT. Du stellst sicher, dass unsere Systeme und Applikationen für die Betriebsführung zuverlässig laufen, sicher sind und kontinuierlich weiterentwickelt werden. Als zentrale Ansprechperson nimmst du Anforderungen auf, berücksichtigst technische Rahmenbedingungen und setzt gemeinsam mit den relevanten Stakeholdern tragfähige Lösungen erfolgreich in den Betrieb um. Wir suchen zwei Power-Personen, die diese spannende Aufgabe nicht nur übernehmen, sondern prägen wollen.

Das erwartet dich

Du übernimmst die Gesamtverantwortung für die Applikationen im Umfeld der Betriebsführungssysteme und stellst sowohl einen stabilen Betrieb als auch deren kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung sicher.
Anforderungen aus dem Business werden von dir aufgenommen, strukturiert und in technische Lösungen sowie Schnittstellen überführt – inklusive Begleitung der Umsetzung. Dabei hast du eine interdisziplinäre Aufgabe und koordinierst dich mit unterschiedlichen Fachabteilungen und Lieferanten.
Von der Idee bis zum Betrieb begleitest du IT- und OT-Projekte und bringst deine Expertise aktiv ein. 
Als zentrale Schnittstelle verbindest du Business-Anforderungen mit IT, OT und Elektrotechnik, berätst bei komplexen Fragestellungen und koordinierst die beteiligten Stakeholder. 
Du stellst die Einhaltung von Cyber-Security-Vorgaben, Prozessen und Qualitätsstandards sicher, verantwortest die Dokumentation und begleitest Anfragen, Assessments sowie Audits.
Du agierst als Koordinationsstelle für den operativen Betrieb, End-Nutzer, Sicherheitsprozesse sowie Themen rund um Notfall- und Business-Continuity-Management. 

Das bringst du mit

Du verfügst über ein Studium auf min. FH-Niveau in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Elektrotechnik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation und bringst Erfahrung im IT-/OT-Umfeld mit.
Grundlagen der elektrischen Energieversorgung und Energieverteilung sind für diese Rolle unabdingbar und bilden die Basis für das Verständnis der Geschäftsprozesse und Systemlandschaft.
Im Requirements Engineering sowie in der Konzeption und Weiterentwicklung von Applikationen und Schnittstellen bist du sattelfest. 
Technische IT und OT Begriffe machen dir keine Angst und du kannst dich mit technischen Systemspezialisten austauschen.
Erfahrung in Projekten sowie ein gutes Verständnis für betriebliche Abläufe zeichnen dich aus. 
Cyber Security, IT-Standards und regulatorische Anfoderungen sind dir bekannt, und du gehst strukturiert sowie lösungsorientiert vor. 
Du kommunizierst adressatengerecht in deutscher Sprache, bewegst dich sicher zwischen Business, IT und Elektrotechnik und arbeitest gerne mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern.

Standplaats: Amersfoort

Uren per week: - 38

Niveau: HBO Bachelor; WO Bachelor

Vakgebied: ICT

Vacaturenummer: 80808

Functiegroep: Burger

Dit ga je doen

Werken bij het ministerie Defensie, maar niet als militair?

Word Software Engineer

Als je kiest voor een baan bij Defensie, dan kies je voor maatschappelijk relevant werk. Je draagt echt iets bij aan een veilig Nederland.

Naast 48.000 beroepsmilitairen werken er ook nog zo’n 21.000 burgers bij Defensie. Ben jij een ervaren software engineer met een passie voor complexe technische uitdagingen? Wil jij bouwen aan de toekomst van gedistribueerde systemen voor Situation rooms, commandocentra en militaire voertuigen?

Als Software engineer ga je onze teams versterken bij het ontwikkelen van dit soort bijzondere software.

Hoogwaardige software vraagt om vaardige softwareontwikkelaars. Als medior ontwikkelaar bij JIVC/Landgebonden IT versterk je het team ‘Externe Koppelingen’. Jij bent de kritieke schakel tussen onze defensiesystemen en internationale partners. Je ontwikkelt en onderhoudt de interfaces die veilig en naadloze informatie-uitwisseling mogelijk maken met onze coalitiepartners binnen de NAVO.

Je vertaalt complexe NAVO-standaarden en protocollen naar robuuste software die faaltolerant is. In een Agile omgeving, aangestuurd volgens SAFe, werk je samen met een multidisciplinaire team om interoperabiliteit te garanderen. Een of twee keer per jaar neem je je werk mee naar het veld om de connectiviteit live te valideren samen met coalitiepartners in live scenario's onder realistische omstandigheden. Jouw rol heeft een directe impact op internationale samenwerking en veiligheid.

Dit vragen wij

Je hebt een afgeronde technische HBO of WO-opleiding (bij voorkeur Informatica of Informatietechnologie) of kan aantonen op dit niveau te kunnen werken.
Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als software engineer met Windows, C# en .Net of ervaring met Linux, C++ evt. in embedded systems.
Ruime ervaring in het participeren in multidisciplinaire ICT-projecten
Je hebt affiniteit met de automatisering van complexe operationele informatiesystemen.
Affiniteit en ervaring met communicatieprotocollen, multithreading en schalingsvraagstukken is zeer wenselijk.
Je hebt goede communicatieve vaardigheden, je kunt overtuigen en neemt initiatief.
Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal in woord en geschrift.
Je hebt een Nederlandse nationaliteit of een gecombineerde vergunning voor verblijf en arbeid (GVVA). Dit is een vergunning die vreemdelingen van buiten de EU, Liechtenstein, Noorwegen, IJsland en Zwitserland het recht geeft om in Nederland te verblijven en te werken voor een periode langer dan drie maanden. Een vergunning is niet nodig voor werknemers uit landen van de Europese Economische Ruimte (EER) en uit Zwitserland. Voor deze landen geldt een vrij verkeer van werknemers.

Wie ben jij:

Je bent analytisch sterk;
Je neemt graag het initiatief;
Je hebt goede communicatieve vaardigheden en je kan goed in een team werken;
Je bent zelfstandig, kritisch en resultaat gedreven;
Je bent kwaliteitsbewust en stelt kwaliteit boven kwantiteit;
Je hebt integriteit hoog in het vaandel staan.

Dit krijg je

Salarisniveau: Burgerschaal IBBAD 11 - Burgerschaal IBBAD 11

Salarisomschrijving: Het genoemde salaris is gebaseerd op een volledige werkweek van 38 uur. Je inschaling wordt gebaseerd op je werkervaring en opleidingsachtergrond.

Maandsalaris: €5.184,00 - €7.114,00

Dienstverband: Tijdelijke aanstelling met zicht op vaste aanstelling

Contractduur: Tijdelijke aanstelling met uitzicht op vast.

Maximaal aantal uren per week: 38

Dit bieden we nog meer

Defensie hecht sterk aan persoonlijke groei en kent goede studiefaciliteiten, hierdoor sta je nooit stil. Je krijgt alle ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen en door te groeien.
Bij Defensie bouw je elke maand 16,33% van het bruto salaris op in het Individueel Keuzebudget. Je kunt het gebruiken voor het kopen van extra verlofuren of voor fiscale doeleinden.
Naast een pensioenregeling bij het ABP ontvang je maandelijks een tegemoetkoming voor woon-werkverkeer of kun je onder gunstige voorwaarden kiezen voor een OV-abonnement met onbeperkt reizen door heel Nederland.

Bijzonderheden

Deze vacature is zowel in- als extern opengesteld. Bij geschiktheid hebben interne kandidaten de voorkeur.
Een veiligheidsonderzoek maakt deel uit van de selectieprocedure.
Een referentiecheck en assessment kunnen onderdeel uitmaken van de selectieprocedure.
Om in aanmerking te komen voor deze functie moet je afkomstig zijn uit een land uit de Europese Economische Ruimte. Mocht dit niet het geval zijn dan beschik je over een gecombineerde vergunning voor verblijf en arbeid (GVVA).
Acquisitie wordt niet op prijs gesteld. Wij verzoeken vriendelijk om geen ongevraagde aanbiedingen, telefoontjes of e-mails te sturen. Dank u voor uw begrip.

Meer over de functiegroep

Organisatienaam

Ministerie van Defensie

Organisatieomschrijving

Defensie zet zich in voor de belangen, welvaart en vrijheid van Nederland. We zijn dagelijks actief in binnen- en buitenland. Onze wereldwijde inzet versterkt de internationale samenwerking en zorgt ervoor dat mensen zich in vrijheid kunnen ontplooien. Nu en in de toekomst.

Bij het ministerie van Defensie werken ongeveer 79 duizend mensen direct en indirect aan vrede en veiligheid. Het ministerie bestaat uit het Commando Materieel & IT (COMMIT), de Bestuursstaf (het departement), de Koninklijke Marine, de Koninklijke Landmacht, de Koninklijke Luchtmacht, de Koninklijke Marechaussee, het Defensie Ondersteuningscommando (DOSCO).

Defensie is een van de grootste werkgevers van Nederland en vertoont overeenkomsten met een groot bedrijf. De operationele commando's (zee-, land- en luchtstrijdkrachten), de Marechaussee, het DOSCO en de COMMIT lijken op werkmaatschappijen.

Organisatie-URL

www.defensie.nl/organisatie/commit

Afdelingsnaam

Commando Materieel en IT

Afdelingsomschrijving

Standplaats: Bernhardkazerne te Amersfoort

Onder de vlag van JIVC, de IT organisatie van defensie, als onderdeel van het Commando Materieel en IT (COMMIT), ga je werken bij de afdeling Landgebonden IT/sectie Systeemontwikkeling en Integratie (SO&I).

COMMIT zet zich in om collega’s in binnen- en buitenland het best mogelijke te bieden: het beste materieel, de beste voorraden en de beste ICT. Zo kunnen zij hun werk zo krachtig en effectief mogelijk doen.

De afdeling Landgebonden IT draagt op basis van diepgaande kennis van operationele gebruikers- en instandhoudingsprocessen, bij aan de vertaling van eisen en wensen naar concrete specificaties, hetzij t.b.v. een eigen software-ontwikkeltraject dan wel t.b.v. een extern aan te besteden ontwikkelopdracht. Landgebonden IT voert daarnaast het systeemmanagement over alle in stand te houden systemen, trainers en simulatoren. Landgebonden IT levert tevens (ook on site) support op de door de afdeling geleverde systemen en levert technische assistentie bij de implementatie en vervanging van deze systemen.

De sectie Systeemontwikkeling en Integratie is verantwoordelijk voor het integreren van extern verworven en/of intern ontwikkelde systemen en het zelf ontwikkelen en onderhouden van systemen.

Visie

Het Commando Materieel & IT (COMMIT) ondersteunt de transitie naar een informatie gestuurde en technologisch hoogwaardige krijgsmacht met het beste materieel en de beste IT. Ons COMMITment is groot om de cruciale rol te versterken als strategisch partner van de Commandant der Strijdkrachten, van de operationele onderdelen en van internationale partners. COMMIT vergroot de impact van de ondersteuning door een integrale en innovatieve aanpak van materieel- en IT-projecten, (wapen)systeemmanagement en ketenlogistiek.

Wij investeren in de kwaliteit van onze mensen en de flexibiliteit en diversiteit van het personeelsbestand. De belangrijkste capaciteiten van COMMIT zijn de kennis en ervaring van ons personeel. Wir sind als eine der führenden europäischen Management- und Technologieberatungen ein echter Tech-Player. Wir sehen uns als Vordenker*innen, handeln und denken strategisch, entwickeln mit unseren Kunden maßgeschneiderte Lösungen, sowie präzise Prozesse und implementieren innovative Technologien. Weltweit sind wir über 50.000 tech-affine und kluge Köpfe – gemeinsam gestalten wir die Zukunft unserer Kunden und die der Gesellschaft.

Bist du bereit, das digitale Europa mitzugestalten?

Stellenbeschreibung

Du entwickelst, konfigurierst und erweiterst Identity-Management-Lösungen auf Basis von One Identity Manager
Kundenspezifische Prozesse, Skripte, Templates, Workflows und Datenmodellerweiterungen setzt du mit den relevanten OneIM-Werkzeugen um
Active Directory, LDAP, Microsoft Entra ID, Exchange Online sowie SAP- und HR-Systeme integrierst du in bestehende Lösungen
Synchronisations-, Provisionierungs-, Deprovisionierungs- und Reconciliation-Prozesse sowie asynchrone ITSM-Schnittstellen entwickelst und betreust du
Du unterstützt Migrationen, Releasewechsel und kontrollierte Transporte über Entwicklungs-, Test- und Produktionsumgebungen
Job-Queue-, Synchronisations-, Connector-, Performance- und Produktionsprobleme analysierst und behebst du inklusive Root-Cause-Analyse
Bei Test, Validierung, Abnahme und Betriebsüberführung wirkst du mit und unterscheidest Standard-Releasewechsel, Customizing, Schnittstellenanpassung und Technologiewechsel
Technische Lösungen dokumentierst du nachvollziehbar und transferierst Know-how an Projekt- und Betriebsteams
Du entwickelst KI-gestützte Lösungsansätze und Automatisierungen, bewertest deren Mehrwert sowie Einsatzgrenzen kritisch und leitest daraus konkrete Impulse ab, bestehende Prozesse weiterzuentwickeln sowie neue zu etablieren
Beratung heißt Flexibilität: Dein Projekteinsatz richtet sich nach unseren Kund*innen und deiner Projektsituation – du arbeitest deutschlandweit in unseren Offices, beim Kunden vor Ort und von zu Hause

Qualifikationen

Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium der (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Mathematik, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder eine vergleichbare Berufsausbildung
Praktische Entwicklungserfahrung mit One Identity Manager in Projekt- oder Betriebsumgebungen bringst du mit
Mehrere OneIM-Komponenten, insbesondere Designer, Manager, Object Browser, Job Queue Info und Synchronization Editor, sind dir vertraut
Du verfügst über Entwicklungskenntnisse in C#/.NET oder belastbare OneIM-Skripting-Erfahrung sowie Kenntnisse in SQL und relationalen Datenbanken
OneIM-Datenmodell, Templates, Prozesse, Events, Job Chains, Skripte und kundenspezifische Erweiterungen verstehst du
Erfahrung mit AD-/LDAP-Anbindungen sowie Provisionierung, Synchronisation und Reconciliation ergänzt dein Profil
Technische Änderungen kannst du sauber testen, dokumentieren und kontrolliert über mehrere Umgebungsstufen transportieren
Deine Fähigkeiten mit One Identity Starling Connect und SuccessFactors-Integration sind besonders wertvoll
Du arbeitest hands-on, analysierst komplexe Fehler systematisch und stimmst dich sicher mit relevanten Schnittstellen ab
Du weißt, wie man KI-Tools gezielt und reflektiert einsetzt, Ergebnisse kritisch bewertet und aktuelle technologische Entwicklungen sowie innovative Impulse wirkungsvoll in deine Arbeit, Projekte und Kundenlösungen einbringst
Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (mind. B2) runden dein Profil ab

Zusätzliche Informationen

Weiterbildung: umfangreiche fachliche und methodische Trainings inkl. Zertifizierungen sowie vielfältige Entwicklungsperspektiven innerhalb des Unternehmens
Work-Life-Balance: hybrides Arbeiten innerhalb von Deutschland und für einen begrenzten Zeitraum in definierten EU-Ländern, Familienservice, Firmenfitness sowie die Möglichkeit zu einem Sabbatical
Flexible Urlaubsgestaltung: 30 Tage Urlaub und die Möglichkeit zur individuellen Erhöhung oder Verringerung des jährlichen Urlaubs um bis zu 5 Tage
SpenditCard: Monatlich stehen dir zusätzlich zum Gehalt 50 Euro steuerfreies Guthaben zur Verfügung, die du flexibel für Shops in deiner Nähe nutzen kannst

Mobilität: Firmenwagen und Dienstfahrrad per Gehaltsumwandlung sowie Bezuschussung des Deutschlandtickets
Unser Mindset: Teamspirit, offene Türen, Duzkultur, gelebte Vielfalt

Vielfalt ist eine wichtige Grundlage unserer Unternehmenskultur. Wir möchten ein inklusives Umfeld schaffen, das die Diversität all unserer 2.700 Mitarbeitenden in Deutschland und Österreich berücksichtigt und in dem du dich bestmöglich entfalten kannst. Denn wir bei Sopra Steria sind davon überzeugt, dass deine Individualität der Schlüssel zu einem nachhaltigen Unternehmenserfolg ist.

jobs.title: C# / .NET DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
JUXT is partnering with a global asset management firm to transform and standardise software delivery across a large application estate.

The organisation supports hundreds of applications built primarily in C#/.NET
and Python
, with delivery pipelines that have evolved independently over many years. The result is a mixture of build processes, deployment tooling and operational practices that vary significantly between teams.

Your mission is to help change that.

You'll join a small, highly experienced DevOps team responsible for designing a modern CI/CD platform based around reusable GitHub Actions workflows and standard deployment patterns. Rather than building one-off pipelines, you'll create engineering products that application teams can adopt with minimal effort—improving consistency, security, observability and deployment reliability across the organisation.

This is a hands-on engineering role with significant influence over how software is built, tested and deployed across a large enterprise.

What You'll Be Working On

Standardised CI/CD Platform -
Design reusable GitHub Actions workflows and deployment templates covering build, test, security scanning, packaging, promotion and production deployment.
Modernising Legacy Delivery -
Migrate applications from Azure DevOps pipelines onto a standard GitHub Actions platform while maintaining production stability and minimising disruption.
Supporting Mixed Estates -
Develop pipeline patterns that support both Kubernetes-based services and traditional Windows Server / VM deployments, allowing teams to modernise at their own pace.
Containerisation -
Work with development teams to containerise applications, adopt 12-factor principles and improve portability across environments.
Security by Default -
Integrate SonarQube, dependency scanning, SAST/DAST, image signing and supply-chain security into every pipeline, ensuring quality and compliance are built into the delivery process.
Infrastructure as Code -
Develop supporting infrastructure using Terraform and Bicep for build runners, deployment environments, identities and shared platform services.
Engineering Enablement -
Produce clear documentation, reusable templates and guidance that make the standard easy to adopt while helping engineering teams improve their delivery practices.

jobs.description:

This role will be a mid or senior level engineer dependant on experience

Why this role exists

Redgate's Foundry is our innovation incubator, the team scanning the horizon for Redgate's next big opportunity. This role exists because that kind of work needs engineers who are genuinely excited by discovery: people who can form a hypothesis, test it fast, and make a clear-eyed call on whether to push forward or change course.

Most ideas won't become products. That's by design. Each experiment sharpens our thinking and improves the odds of finding the one that will. If you're motivated by that kind of challenge, where the destination isn't fixed and the work is never the same twice, this is the role for you.

About Redgate

Redgate brings together people who want to do their best work in an environment built on trust, accountability, and collaboration.

We build solutions that help data professionals securely manage the data and databases that their organisations depend on, a space that's only becoming more critical as systems scale, data regulations increase, and AI adoption accelerates.

Why join our engineering team?

You'll work in a team that cares about collaboration, craft and quality, not just in how we build, but in choosing what to build, finding the shortest path to the questions that matter most.
There’s real scope to grow your skills and impact, with clear pathways and support.
We value sustainable delivery, good ways of working and time to improve how we build.

About the role

The Foundry operates differently to the rest of Redgate's product teams. You won't be handed a roadmap. Instead, you'll work across the full arc of innovation — from horizon-scanning and ideation through to early-stage research, rapid prototyping, and working directly with customers to validate what you're building.

You'll be part of a small cross-functional team (a Tech Lead plus four to six Software and Machine Learning Engineers), and you'll regularly run projects in parallel: contributing to ongoing experiments while also exploring entirely new directions. The tech stack is deliberately varied, the right tool for the job, not a fixed list, spanning C#, TypeScript, Python, and more across desktop, web, API, database, and ML development.

What makes this role different:

You'll work on problems where there is no established answer and you'll have the autonomy to explore them seriously.
Your work sits at the intersection of software engineering, customer insight, and product thinking; it's rare to find all three in one role.
You'll use and help shape how Redgate adopts agentic coding and AI development tools, not as an afterthought, but as a core part of how the team works.
The scope is genuinely broad: a typical day could see you balancing technical prototypes, customer interviews, and competitor teardowns.

What makes you a great fit

Proven experience using AI coding tools. You've used them extensively, understand their limitations, and have developed ways to work around them productively and safely.
Strong software design and coding skills across modern languages, particularly C#, TypeScript, or Python, enough to guide and review AI-generated code with confidence.
Hands-on experience building agentic systems using frameworks such as LangGraph, Microsoft Agentic Framework, or MCP, with a solid understanding of LLM capabilities and risks.
Experience designing and running experiments to validate ideas quickly, using technical prototypes, customer feedback, and lean startup principles to test assumptions and make clear decisions.
Comfortable engaging directly with customers and stakeholders: running interviews, demos, and concierge-style validation processes, and communicating findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
A product mindset; you think in terms of user value, outcomes, and market fit, not just features or technical delivery.

What we offer

Salary range: £55,000-£80,000
Hybrid working: home and Cambridge office
Monthly wellbeing allowance and generous paid time off
Genuine investment in learning, development, and career progression
Private health insurance

What happens next

Your application will be reviewed by a person, we don't use AI or automated tools to assess applications. Every profile is read by one of our Talent Partners.

You'll hear back within a few days, whether it's a next step or a no, we aim to respond promptly so you're not left wondering.

Our interview process is straightforward and consistent, you'll find more detail on our typical hiring process below, so you know what's coming and why.

Belonging at Redgate

We believe that people do their best work in an environment built on respect, fairness, and trust and that diverse perspectives lead to better outcomes. Redgate is an equal opportunity employer, and we make hiring decisions based on skill, potential, and alignment with our values.

jobs.description:
About Us

Every business needs to know who they’re really working with whether it’s suppliers, investors, partners, or third parties. At Xapien, we’re reinventing how organisations do that, combining speed, scale and accuracy with cutting-edge AI.

Since 2018, we’ve grown from a deep-tech startup to a global player in AI-driven due diligence and risk intelligence. 2024 was a landmark year as we closed a $10M Series A, earned recognition in the Chartis RiskTech100® and Everest Group’s Leading 50™, and expanded our products, markets and customer base.

2025 was even bigger:
With new regulations, rising compliance pressure and growing reputation risks, organisations everywhere are demanding smarter, faster ways to work and they’re turning to us. Customers worldwide from global law firms and private banks to universities and nonprofits rely on Xapien to turn days of manual research into trusted insights, delivered in minutes.

Our momentum so far

Customers in a diverse range of industries, with particular growth in wealth management, financial services and supply chain onboarding.

Demand accelerating beyond our UK headquarters, across multiple continents with new customers in the Middle East, Asia, and Oceania.

Why this is an exciting time to join

This isn’t just another job role; it’s an opportunity to shape the future of the due diligence industry with a market-leading product trusted by global organisations. Whether you’re in marketing, communications, sales, or finance, you’ll play a critical role in driving growth, building credibility, and defining how we connect our product to a rapidly evolving market.

We’re scaling fast with more customers, more releases, and bigger regulatory and market challenges. Expectations are rising, due diligence now means real-time insight, delivered efficiently and with impact. You won’t just be executing campaigns, closing deals, or managing numbers, you’ll be influencing strategy, optimising processes, and helping position a brand that’s setting the new standard for trust and transparency.

For people who love learning, innovating, and making an impact that matters now is the moment to be a part of Xapien.

The role

We are looking for an experienced Senior Infrastructure Engineer to help lead the design, implementation, and maintenance of our cloud infrastructure. Working directly with our Head of Platform Engineering, you will play a key role in shaping the technical future of our product. This position involves a mix of hands-on technical expertise and strategic planning, with a focus on optimizing our systems for scalability, reliability, and maintainability. We are seeking someone with a strong background in building and deploying scalable cloud-native applications on AWS, experience with microservices architecture, and a track record of automating and improving infrastructure processes to improve overall developer experience.

Here’s what you will be responsible for

Designing, building, and maintaining scalable, reliable, and secure cloud infrastructure on AWS using technologies including EC2, ECS, Lambda, SQS, DynamoDB, RDS, Cognito, S3, and SNS.
Developing and deploying cloud-native applications following microservice design patterns.
Implementing infrastructure as code using tools like Terraform or CloudFormation to automate deployment and scaling processes.
Automating deployment pipelines and CI/CD processes to ensure rapid and reliable delivery of software.
Monitoring system performance, troubleshooting issues, and optimizing infrastructure for performance and cost-efficiency.
Collaborating with the development team to ensure seamless integration and deployment of applications.
Ensuring best practices in security, compliance, and data protection are followed across all infrastructure components.
Mentoring and providing guidance to junior engineers, promoting a culture of continuous learning and improvement.

Your skills & experience

Must-haves to be successful in this role

Strong experience in Go or C# programming languages (ideally both).
Extensive experience in building and deploying scalable cloud-native applications on AWS using technologies including EC2, ECS, Lambda, SQS, DynamoDB, RDS, Cognito, S3, and SNS.
Experience architecting cloud-native applications following microservice design patterns.
Proficiency with infrastructure as code tools like Terraform or CloudFormation.
Deep understanding of AWS services, cloud architecture, and best practices.
Experience with containerization technologies like Docker and orchestration tools like Kubernetes or ECS.
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and tools like Github Actions, GitLab CI, or CircleCI.
Strong understanding of networking concepts, security principles, and system monitoring.
Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to break down complex problems into manageable tasks.
Track record of designing and implementing scalable, reliable distributed, heterogeneous systems.
Deep knowledge of cloud architecture and development best practices, design principles, and patterns.
Experience working with everything from relational databases though to a multitude of NoSQL stores.
Experience working with technologies, including message queues, event streams, authentication, caching, API hosting, containers, lambdas, FaaS patterns, orchestration / workflow engines and search engines.

Job summary

From healthcare to artificial intelligence, energy to national security, we provide legal advice to government departments on nation-changing subjects.

At Government Legal Department we have a vital, single-minded purpose: to help the Government govern well within the rule of law. This is complemented by our exciting vision to be an outstanding legal organisation, committed to the highest standards of service and professionalism and a brilliant place to work where we can all thrive and fulfil our potential.

Our work touches almost every aspect of public life. We are the largest provider of legal services across government, working on high profile matters.

Our respected professionals are involved in everything from regulation and litigation to advice on drafting legislation. They provide expertise to the full range of government departments. We are at the heart of delivering the government’s priorities and our success depends on our people.

GLD is a non-ministerial government department headed by the Treasury Solicitor, our Permanent Secretary, and employs nearly 3000 people, including over 2600 legal professionals. We have offices nationwide, in Bristol, Leeds, inner and outer London and Manchester. Our lawyers can also be located within other departments and overseas.

GLD also depends on a range of cross-government professionals to provide our corporate services. These play an essential part in helping GLD to achieve its purpose and truly deliver much more than law.

Through agile delivery and user-centred approaches, we design and deliver products and services in partnership with the people who use them, ensuring solutions meet real needs and deliver lasting value.

We specialise in helping organisations advance their cloud maturity guiding transformation, strengthening security, and maximising the value of their technology investments.

We are seeking a highly skilled and customer focused Solutions Architect to join our growing team. Act as the technical lead during the presales process, engaging with customers to understand their business objectives, technical challenges, and transformation goals.

Public Cloud (AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform)

jobs.title: Bliv Software Engineer til Case Management løsninger i en foreningsejet Nykredit-koncern
jobs.location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
Vil du være med til at bygge løsninger, der gør en mærkbar forskel i hverdagen for kolleger på tværs af Nykredit-koncernen, ved at digitalisere og automatisere sagsbehandling i vores kerneprocesser? Så er du måske vores nye kollega.

Vi søger en Software Engineer med solide Java-færdigheder, som har lyst til at tage ansvar for udvikling af applikationer, flows og integrationer til case management-løsninger. Du arbejder tæt på forretningen og leverer stabile, sikre løsninger, som bliver brugt hver dag – og du får samtidig mulighed for at præge retningen gennem fagligt ejerskab og sparring i teamet.

Nykredit-koncernen er ejet af en forening af vores kunder, Forenet Kredit. Det betyder, at vi kan dele vores fremgang med vores kunder, når det går os godt, og at vi påtager os et særligt ansvar over for det samfund, vi er en del af. Det vil du også opleve, når vi kan byde dig velkommen som Software Engineer.

Dine vigtigste arbejdsopgaver bliver:

Udvikle case management applikationer: processer og services, der understøtter konkrete forretningsprocesser.
Designe og implementere integrationer til Nykredit-koncernens øvrige systemer.
Bygge robuste REST-API’er og arbejde med datahåndtering (fx via Hibernate/JPA eller direkte mod databaser).
Sikre kvalitet i kode og løsninger gennem gode udviklingsmønstre, genbrug, code reviews og test.
Sparre tæt med product owners, proceskonsulenter, arkitekter og andre udviklere om design af løsninger – fra første skitse til drift.
Bidrage til DevOps og SDLC (CI/CD, logging, monitorering), i tæt samarbejde med kolleger med platform- og infrastrukturansvar.

Du får en rolle, hvor du først og fremmest er hands-on udvikler, men samtidig er med til at løfte niveauet på tværs af teamet gennem fagligt ejerskab og sparring.

Er det dig, vi leder efter?

Vi søger dig, der trives med at tage ejerskab og bygge løsninger, som er i drift og skaber værdi i hverdagen. Mere konkret ser vi gerne, at du:

har erfaring med softwareudvikling,
har solide færdigheder i Java,
har erfaring med REST-API’er, integrationer og datamodellering (JSON/XML, SQL, Hibernate/JPA eller lignende),
har erfaring med sagsstyringssystemer eller workflow-platforme (BPM),
er vant til at arbejde med Git og moderne udviklingspraksis (branching, code reviews, pull requests),
har kendskab til eller lyst til at arbejde med Azure-tjenester (fx API Management, Functions, Service Bus/Event Grid, Key Vault),
tænker i skalerbare, vedligeholdbare løsninger og går op i kvalitet, sikkerhed og performance.

Til gengæld lover vi både udvikling og muligheder til dig, der vil og kan.

Vores stack (så ved du, hvad du lander i):

IDE: Axon Ivy Designer (Eclipse-baseret), IntelliJ, Visual Studio Code.
Build: pipeline: GitHub Actions.
Requirements: Jira.
SCM: GitHub.
Containerization & platform: Docker på Azure/OpenShift.
Logging/Metrics: Datadog, Splunk -> Grafana (på vej).
SAST/SCA: SonarQube, Snyk/GitHub Advanced Security.
Teknologier: Java EE, REST, OAuth2/OIDC, Hibernate/JPA mm.

Bliv en del af Intelligent Automation-familien

Du bliver en del af Intelligent Automation Engineering i Nykredit-koncernens Engineering enhed – en enhed med 80+ udviklere, arkitekter og andre tekniske profiler på tværs af København, Aalborg og Warszawa. Vi arbejder med AI, automatisering og andre teknologier og leverer både platforme og færdige løsninger til vores kerne forretningsområder. Din base bliver Nykredit Huset i Nordhavn eller Skelagervej i Aalborg med mulighed for én hjemmearbejdsdag om ugen.

Vi glæder os til at tage godt imod dig som vores nye kollega.

Din nærmeste leders ledelsesstil

Du refererer til Oliver Gruszczynski, Head of Automation Engineering. Oliver er tillidsfuld, tilgængelig og transparent og prioriterer et humoristisk og ærligt samarbejdsmiljø. Du får løbende sparring, faste 1:1-samtaler og et tydeligt fokus på din faglige og personlige udvikling.

Vil du vide mere?

Du er velkommen til at kontakte mig, Head of Automation Engineering Oliver Gruszczynski på tlf. 44 55 99 58, hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen.

Har du spørgsmål til rekrutteringsprocessen, skriv til nytjob@nykredit.dk.

Vi inviterer løbende til samtaler og ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning og dit CV.

Description & Requirements

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

EA SPORTS is one of the most iconic brands in entertainment with over 25 years of innovation, passion, and connection of millions of players across the globe to their favorite sports, teams, and players. At the heart of EA SPORTS is the EA SPORTS™ FC franchise. EA SPORTS™ FC is the world's #1 best-selling video game with over 200M engaged players across multiple platforms, including console, PC, and mobile.

As a .NET Full Stack Software Engineer - EA SPORTS™ FC, you are an essential part of the game creation process and are involved in the architectural design and implementation of the Content Tools.

Job Location: Hybrid from our office in Bucharest, Romania

Responsibilities

Reporting to the Development Director, we are looking for an experienced .NET Full-Stack Software Engineer with web development experience and an in-depth understanding of C#/.NET and Single Page Application frameworks. You have experience in both designing and developing RESTful applications, and have the desire to deliver without sacrificing quality.

As a central team within the EA SPORTS™ FC project, our team delivers the tools that are used by Live Content producers to support many dynamic features in our game. As such, you would work with our internal customers to develop new features or upgrade existing ones. Whether you prefer working on new functionality, improving existing implementation, or fixing production issues, you will have the chance to contribute to applications that have an impact across the entire EA SPORTS™ FC project.

You will work with internal partners to develop, and deliver new features or upgrade existing ones
You will participate in planning sessions and daily SCRUM-style stand-up meetings
You will ensure the quality of the code by participating in the code review process
You will solve complex technical issues in a time-sensitive fashion

Required Technical Skills

C#, .NET 10, JavaScript, TypeScript
Experience with designing RESTful APIs
Single Page Application frameworks such as Angular, React or Vue.js
Experience in writing efficient SQL queries
Experience with source control software such as Git or Perforce
Excellent debugging skills

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Software Engineering or equivalent
Good level of C# and an understanding of JavaScript/TypeScript
2+ years of professional software development experience
Experience with object-oriented design patterns
Experience communicating with other engineers, producers, and designers

Bonus Skills

Experience with gRPC and GraphQL protocols
Experience with Docker and Docker Compose
Experience with Cloud technologies (GCP, Azure, AWS)

About Electronic Arts

We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.

We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.

Electronic Arts is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will also consider employment qualified applicants with criminal records in accordance with applicable law. EA also makes workplace accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities as required by applicable law.

jobs.location: Pozuelo de Alarcón, Community of Madrid, Spain
jobs.description:
At Verisure, we do something amazing every day. By protecting what matters most, we change lives for the better.
We are the leading provider of professionally monitored security services with 24/7 response in Europe and Latin America. More than 6 million families and small businesses in 18 countries rely on our innovative technology to protect what matters most to them. We integrate product development, design, sales, installation services and a 24/7 professional monitoring solution. We have a track record of continuous growth, as well as exciting plans to continue expanding, transforming, and leading the market into the future.

Our success depends on our people, and we invest in them every day. Working with Verisure is being part of an industry-leading, world-class company that has a strong entrepreneurial spirit.

About The Role

We are seeking Solutions Architects
and Enterprise Architects
to lead key technological transformation projects
, defining end-to-end architectures
and working closely with both our Technology teams and Business areas. You’ll be a key mediator, aligning teams, solutions, and technologies to ensure availability, scalability, and performance
.

Responsibilities

Participate in the discovery and analysis phases of new products, services, and systems.
Design end-to-end solutions in on-prem, cloud, or hybrid environments.
Mediate between teams to align architectural decisions.
Support in selecting key technologies and driving prototypes when needed.
Contribute to building architecture patterns, reference solutions, architectural principles, technical recommendations, reference architecture, and reference processes among other assets.
Be involved in technology, roadmap planning, and architecture evangelism.

What You’ll Bring

10+ years of IT experience.
Proven prior experience as an Architect (esp., relevant if part of other portfolio-based industries like utilities, telco, insurance, etc.).
Proven prior experience in end-to-end design of complex architectures.
Ability to communicate effectively in English and Spanish with multidisciplinary teams.
Experience with enterprise processes (additional experience around customer journeys will be a plus).
Experience with cloud architecture (Azure, AWS) and agile methodologies.
Expertise in APIS, microservices and event-driven architectures.

Key Skills

Strong communication skills to explain and convince on technical risks and solutions.
Multitasker, comfortable dealing with multiple initiatives/tasks in parallel.
A hands-on architect who can dive into technical details when necessary.
Goal-oriented work approach with autonomy.
Proactive and collaborative, with the ability to mediate between teams.
Curious about new technologies and trends.

Location

The role will be based in Madrid

If you’re not sure you meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway — you might have a good fit for this role or another opportunity within our team.

Verisure will offer you

Hybrid model Work from home and at our great Madrid offices in Pozuelo de Alarcón (El Barrial- Centro Comercial)
Lunch included at our canteen You won’t need to pay for your daily meal when you are at the office! :)
Dynamic and vibrant environment 💥Our office is an open-plan space in which you will be able to interact with the best professional from different teams at all levels.
International stakeholder projects
Learning and training programs
Career development opportunities

Strong Fit With Our Company DNA

Passionate in Everything We Do
: Our people bring a contagious energy and a sense of urgency that is unmistakable. We create a vision and inspire others around that vision with full engagement and focus. We are all-in, and we love what we do.

Committed to Making a Difference
: We are courageous, we deliver what we promise through hard work and resilience. We make a difference, through operating with discipline and doing what is needed. We are hands-on, and we aren’t afraid to get into the detail. We deliver results and we execute with excellence.

Always Innovating
: Our people make the impossible possible; it’s a continuous state of mind. We are purpose-driven, curious and we challenge the status quo. We believe good ideas travel, we share and reapply. We take smart risks, and we are not afraid to fail. We believe innovation can be big or small.

Winning as a Team
: We are determined to become number 1, and to do that we need to listen to one another, collaborate and work together. We play our part, fuelled by a winning attitude and a fighting spirit. We celebrate our successes. We play to our strengths and our diversity to deliver even better outcomes, while developing and supporting one another. We believe that together we go further, and that nothing is impossible.

With Trust & Responsibility
: Our people take responsibility for the people we protect. We are accountable and reliable. We role model operating with integrity. We trust and empower one another to do the right thing, always. We deliver on our promise through world-class expertise and meticulous know-how. And, we do this with humility while being honoured to play such an important role in society.

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Fullstack Quality)
jobs.description:
Software Engineer Mid 1

Blip is a leading tech company focused on software engineering solutions for sports entertainment.

We operate at scale. As part of Flutter Entertainment, we play an essential role in the Group's goal of becoming the global leader in online sports betting and iGaming, developing innovative products and platforms for over 14 million monthly customers worldwide.

We are serious about Tech. We are problem-solvers with big ambitions, keeping a people-first mindset at the core of our work. We prioritize flexibility as we strive to deliver the best technological products and tackle the greatest industry challenges.

Recognizing that everyone brings their own strengths, backgrounds and new perspectives, we empower you to be yourself. That uniqueness shapes the culture of belonging we are so proud of.

The Role

We are looking for a skilled hybrid engineer to join a dedicated, specialized team focused on driving

the Quality Engineering strategy across our area. Instead of working within a single product squad,

you will use your full-stack development skills to help build and maintain internal platforms, tooling,

and robust automation frameworks that empower all engineering teams to deliver with excellence.

Reporting to an Engineering Manager, you will act as a key bridge between software development

and quality assurance. You will collaborate on solutions that enhance system resilience, automate

testing scenarios, and elevate our technical standards. If you are a builder who loves solving

structural problems, writing clean code (from Go to React), and creating tools that make other

developers' lives easier, this is the role for you

What You’ll Be Doing

Platform & Tooling Development: Use your full-stack skills to develop and maintaininternal tools, dashboards (React/Next.js), and backend services (Golang) designed tomonitor and enhance product quality.
Quality Strategy Execution: Collaborate with senior engineers and management toimplement and evolve the quality engineering strategy, helping to establish best practicesand metrics for product teams.
Automation Frameworks: Build, maintain, and scale test automation frameworks (API,Integration, End-to-End) that can be easily adopted by distributed product teams.
Resilience Engineering: Help design and implement automated processes thatcontinuously validate system resilience, data integrity, and high availability across ourarchitecture.
CI/CD Integration: Work on integrating testing platforms directly into our CI/CD pipelines,ensuring deployments remain rapid, reliable, and automated.
Quality Advocacy: Act as a quality advocate for product squads. Participate in cross-teamcode reviews and help champion Test-Driven approaches (like BDD and ATDD).

What You’ll Bring

Software Development Experience: 2 to 4 years of experience with back-end programming(e.g., Golang, C#) and working experience (1+ years) in front-end development with Reactand its ecosystem.
Quality & Automation Focus: Experience as a Software Development Engineer in Test(SDET), Quality Engineer, or a Full-Stack Developer with a heavy focus on automatedtesting and tooling.
System Architecture & Resilience: Good understanding of system design, data flow, andexperience working with distributed systems and messaging (e.g., Kafka, SQS, Kinesis).
Testing Frameworks: Practical knowledge of testing at the API layer (e.g., REST), UIautomation, and an understanding of BDD and ATDD methodologies. Database Knowledge: Experience with SQL databases (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL) andfamiliarity with NoSQL (e.g., DynamoDB) or caching (e.g., Redis).
DevOps & Infrastructure: Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, version control(Git/GitHub), Linux navigation, and basic shell scripting.
Communication: Clear and collaborative communication skills, with the ability to documenttechnical designs, write runbooks, and work proactively in a dynamic environment.

This is what you should have. What do we have, you ask? Well...you can check our amazing perks & benefits
right here! 

So ... are you in?

Equal opportunities

At Blip, we are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We strongly encourage people from all backgrounds, ways of thinking, and working to apply.

We are committed to including everyone
regardless of their race, disability, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, and religion.

Everyone brings different perspectives and experiences; you don’t have to meet all the requirements listed to apply for this role.

If you need any adjustments to apply for the position and to ensure this role aligns with your needs, please send an email to accommodations@blip.pt.

We will only respond to inquiries related to disabilities.

new_jobs.title: Middle/Senior Unity Developer R&D
new_jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Middle/Senior Unity Developer R&D based in Netherlands.

As a Middle/Senior Unity Developer R&D, you’ll help evolve a live mobile game by building new gameplay systems, LiveOps features, and scalable technical solutions.

You’ll work across the full development lifecycle, from implementing new mechanics to improving architecture, performance, stability, and maintainability.

A strong focus of the role is on modern AI-assisted development, with opportunities to integrate AI agents into real production workflows and automate recurring engineering tasks.

You’ll investigate real-world production issues using telemetry and profiling data, ensuring a smooth experience across a wide range of mobile devices.

The role also offers significant technical ownership, including participation in architectural decisions, code reviews, optimization initiatives, and development practices.

You’ll collaborate closely with other technical and product-focused team members while contributing ideas that can improve both engineering efficiency and the game itself.

This is an R&D-oriented opportunity for a developer who enjoys solving complex technical problems, experimenting with new tools, and seeing their work make a measurable product impact.

Accountabilities

Develop and maintain gameplay systems and features using Unity and C# within a released mobile game, while evolving architecture and reducing technical debt.
Implement and maintain LiveOps functionality, including events, promotions, seasonal content, and A/B testing.
Work with Addressables, Asset Bundles, CDN delivery, and Remote Configs to enable content and feature updates without requiring a full application release.
Actively use AI agents such as Cursor, Claude Code, or equivalent tools in day-to-day development on a real production codebase.
Create and maintain internal AI skills, rules, and agent instructions that automate recurring team workflows while taking responsibility for the quality of generated results.
Investigate and resolve ANRs, crashes, freezes, OOM issues, and other production problems using real telemetry and diagnostic data.
Optimize CPU usage, memory consumption, startup time, application size, and downloadable content for different classes of Android devices.
Integrate and maintain advertising, analytics, monetization, and third-party SDKs while ensuring tracking and event implementation remain accurate.
Conduct code reviews and contribute to important technical and architectural decisions.
Share effective AI-assisted development practices and help improve the team's engineering workflows.
Profile and optimize Android and iOS applications using tools such as Unity Profiler, Crashlytics, and Android Vitals.
Investigate performance regressions and follow complex technical issues from symptoms through root-cause analysis, implementation, and validation of results.
Consider product metrics such as retention, CPI, and LTV when evaluating technical and gameplay decisions.

Requirements

3+ years of commercial experience with Unity and C#, including experience working on released mobile games and supporting projects through LiveOps rather than only developing them prior to launch.
Strong understanding of Unity project architecture, including design patterns, dependency injection with tools such as Zenject or VContainer, asynchronous programming with UniTask, Unity lifecycle, memory management, and garbage collection.
Practical experience with AI development agents such as Cursor, Claude Code, or comparable tools, including the ability to decompose tasks, provide appropriate context from large codebases, and validate generated code.
Experience with MCP, including Unity MCP or similar approaches, as well as skills, rules, and agent-instruction workflows.
Ability to document team development practices in a way that allows AI agents to reproduce them consistently.
Hands-on experience with Addressables, Asset Bundles, CDN delivery, Remote Configs, versioning, caching, and fallback scenarios.
Strong profiling and optimization experience across Android and/or iOS, including investigation of ANRs, crashes, OOM issues, and production performance regressions.
Understanding of low-end Android devices, device fragmentation, and mobile build-size optimization.
Experience integrating third-party SDKs for advertising, analytics, and in-app purchases.
Familiarity with Git workflows, code review practices, and CI/CD.
Ability to take a complex technical problem from symptom identification through root-cause analysis, solution implementation, and verification of the outcome.
Understanding of product metrics such as retention, CPI, and LTV.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a proactive approach to technical challenges.
Ability to work independently, take ownership of technical decisions, and communicate complex engineering topics clearly.
Experience in an R&D-oriented environment is advantageous.
Professional Ukrainian language proficiency is expected.

Benefits

Fully remote work within Europe, with remote-first flexibility.
Personal benefit budget that can be allocated toward insurance, education, fitness, or other areas supporting personal wellbeing.
Performance-based bonuses recognizing meaningful results, initiative, and contribution to team success.
High level of autonomy with minimal bureaucracy and the opportunity to influence technical and product decisions.
Professional development through learning opportunities, internal training, and strategic sessions.
Opportunity to work with modern AI-assisted development tools and contribute to innovative engineering practices.
Collaborative team environment focused on shared ownership and collective results.
Direct opportunity to contribute to the evolution of a live mobile game and its underlying technology.
Full-time position within a Gameplay Development environment.
Interview process consisting of a recruiter interview, test assignment, technical interview, reference collection, and offer stage.

Warum SoftwareOne?

SoftwareOne ist ein globaler Anbieter für Software- und Cloud-Lösungen. Mit einer Präsenz in über 70 Ländern und mehr als 12.000 Mitarbeitenden unterstützen wir Unternehmen dabei, ihre Software-Investitionen zu optimieren, Anwendungen zu modernisieren und das volle Potenzial von Cloud, Data und AI zu erschließen.

Was uns ausmacht, sind die Menschen bei SoftwareOne. Wir ermöglichen Zusammenarbeit über Ländergrenzen hinweg, fördern kontinuierliches Lernen und schaffen Raum für Entwicklung in einer sich ständig wandelnden Technologielandschaft. Ob dein Fokus auf Technologie, Customer Success oder Business Operations liegt – deine Ideen zählen und dein Beitrag macht einen Unterschied.

Werde Teil eines globalen Teams, in dem du deine Fähigkeiten weiterentwickelst, mit führenden Technologien arbeitest und echten Mehrwert für unsere Kunden schaffst.

Die Rolle

Suchst du eine Rolle, in der du dich tief auf komplexe Microsoft-Azure-Infrastrukturen spezialisieren und technische Entscheidungen prägen kannst?
Möchtest du nicht nur „Tickets abarbeiten“, sondern langfristig Kundenumgebungen mitgestalten, modernisieren und sicherer machen?
Bist du bereit in Enterprise Azure Umgebungen unserer Kunden der wirklich Wirkung zu erzielen?

Bundesweit, Deutschland | Arbeitsmodell:
Hybrid / Remote mit Vor-Ort-Einsätzen | Sprachen
:

Vollzeit | Rufbereitschaft und gelegentliche Vor-Ort-Einsätze

Unsere Schwerpunkte liegen in den Bereichen Data Center, Storage, Backup, Windows, Linux, Virtualisierung sowie im Infrastruktur Support.

Als Azure Cloud Engineer (gn) übernimmst du technische Verantwortung für geschäftskritische Managed-Service-Umgebungen auf Microsoft Azure. Du stellst den stabilen, sicheren Betrieb sicher, analysierst Störungen und entwickelst gemeinsam mit Cloud-, Infrastruktur- und Entwicklungsteams nachhaltige Verbesserungen.

Deine Aufgaben

Betrieb, Monitoring und Optimierung komplexer Microsoft-Azure-Infrastrukturen
Analyse und Behebung anspruchsvoller Incidents sowie Ableitung nachhaltiger Maßnahmen
Automatisierung wiederkehrender Aufgaben mit PowerShell, Bash und Azure Runbooks
Administration von Azure-Netzwerken, virtuellen Maschinen, Datenbanken, Identitäten, Berechtigungen und Richtlinien
